capabilities: Reorganize note content into Tasks, Notes, and Links sections
Expand the selection across paragraph, section, and note
Delete task markers as one unit with Backspace or Delete
Show a floating cut, copy, and formatting toolbar for selected text
Delete a note and update links to it in other notes
disambiguation: Not a replacement editor; it is a bundle of independent editing helpers, each switched on or off separately in settings.
extras: Installable via BRAT or manual file copy. Underlines and any saved colors or highlights are stored in the plugin's local data, not in Markdown, so they won't appear in other Markdown apps and new colors can no longer be set. Works locally with no account, network requests, or telemetry.
intentEvidence: The mini toolbar is based on xRyul's Mini Toolbar V2, which builds on Quorafind's Mini Toolbar.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to tidy note layout, expand selections stepwise, delete task markers as a unit, or delete a file while updating links to it in other notes.
